title: Application and Petition of Canal Electric Company, pursuant to General Laws Chapter 164, Section 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell on a negotiated basis First and General Mortgage Bonds to Facilitate the issuance of Industrial Revenue Bonds by the New Hampshire Industrial Development Authority (the "NHIDA"), in the aggregate principal amount of up to $10,0000,000; to authorize the execution of a loan agreement with the NHIDA; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15; for an exemption from the par value and face amount requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15A; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate.
filings: Loan and trust agreement among the Industrial Development Authority of the State of New Hampshire & Canal Electric Company and the First National Bank of Boston, as Trustee dated 12/1/90. Canal Electric Company to CitiBank, NA Trustee, Third supplemental indenture dated 12/1/90 First and General Mortgage Indenture, dated 9/1/76, and Canal Electirc Company to CitiBank, NA, Trustee, Fourth Supplemental Indenture dated 12/1/90 to First and General Mortgage Indenture.
